author: More Perfect Union
description:
We went to a World Cup tailgate, and talked to fans who spent thousands of dollars just to sit near the nosebleeds.

People told us this World Cup has turned into an elitist event.

“As a fan, I felt slighted" — is what we were told outside a match in LA.

Producer: Dina Elshinnawi
Editor: Zach Ben-Amots
Videographer: Sam Rosenthal
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: They paid thousands for the World Cup — and could barely see a thing

description:
Trump showed Iran one thing — their strategy works.

Iran shut down a huge chunk of the global economy, and Trump is now giving them everything they want.

Meanwhile US taxpayers spent billions bombing Iran, and might have to shell out billions more to rebuild it.
